scope: Read-only review of the hardware-bounded sampling repair and existing eighteen-case artifacts; no new simulation, test campaign, GPU, approval, or promotion was performed.
limitations: This review establishes the project native motor-limit policy for its configured Honeywell_HR16 models, not a universal manufacturer hardware specification or flight calibration.
The terminated runtime objects cannot be directly re-inspected; constructor and clamp source bindings are corroborated by actual applied-torque and effective-limit telemetry.
formal_training_qualified is a deterministic physics qualification field; it does not grant formal diagnostic qualification, expert approval, or training_ready.

telemetry_type_contract.numeric: time_s, all adcs physical trace fields except adcs.event.active_effects, and sensor/command/estimate projection fields must be parseable finite numbers.
telemetry_type_contract.availability: status.adcs.rw.available_0 is a boolean CSV field, valid serialized values True/False.
telemetry_type_contract.active_effects: adcs.event.active_effects is a categorical string: empty or the case declared simulator_effect.
telemetry_type_contract.labels: label.* are categorical/boolean ground-truth fields, not floating-point physical measurements.
